title: wacal events
description: What the agent hands to scripts/calendar_upsert.py: a list of calendar events extracted from WhatsApp messages.

start.description: YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day event, or an ISO-8601 datetime WITH offset (e.g. 2026-10-04T18:30:00+01:00) for a timed one.

end.description: Same format as start. Optional: timed events default to +1h, all-day events to the same day. Multi-day all-day events give the last day (inclusive).

description.description: Context worth keeping: who said it, quoted message text, caveats.

source_message_ids.description: ids of the messages this event was inferred from. Drives idempotency: same messages + same title = same calendar event.

confidence.description: How sure the extraction is. Below WACAL_MIN_CONFIDENCE (0.6) the event is reported but not written.

source_key.description: Only when updating an event created in an earlier run (copy its wacal_key from calendar_search.py). Otherwise omit.
